brief:
A military order issued November 17 has placed neighborhoods within the Tulkarm and Nur Shams refugee camps under Israeli control until December 31, 2028, Eye on Palestine reported. Bulldozers, earth barriers, and soldier encampments have transformed the camps into a closed military zone.

The order effectively converts the two camps into restricted areas, preventing residents from accessing their homes and livelihoods for more than four years.
